targets.rawSql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM halts WHERE halted_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM trades WHERE created_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM signals WHERE created_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours'

SELECT bs.bot_id, bs.state, CASE WHEN bs.paper_clock_started_at IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE GREATEST(0, FLOOR(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (NOW() - bs.paper_clock_started_at)) / 86400)::int) END AS paper_day, ROUND(bs.promotion_score::numeric, 3) AS score, bs.allocation_pct, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM trades t WHERE t.bot_id = bs.bot_id AND t.mode='paper' AND t.fill_status='open') AS open_pos, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM trades t WHERE t.bot_id = bs.bot_id AND t.created_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours') AS trades_24h, bs.halt_reason, bs.updated_at FROM bot_state bs ORDER BY bs.bot_id

SELECT process_name, last_ping_at, EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (NOW() - last_ping_at))::int AS seconds_ago, CASE WHEN last_ping_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '2 minutes' THEN 'live' ELSE 'stale' END AS status FROM heartbeats ORDER BY process_name
SELECT bot_id, halt_type, severity, halted_at, resumed_at, LEFT(reason, 80) AS reason FROM halts WHERE halted_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days' ORDER BY halted_at DESC LIMIT 30
SELECT computed_at AS time, bot_id AS metric, promotion_score AS value FROM scores WHERE computed_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '14 days' ORDER BY computed_at
